post.meaning: There is no greater gain than virtue, and no greater loss than forgetting it.
post.caption:
तिरुक्कुरल की एक पंक्ति: दो हज़ार साल पुरानी, आज भी सच 🌿

📖 Thiruvalluvar, Thirukkural, Kural 32

Save कर लें, मुश्किल दिन में काम आएगा। 🔖

#thirukkural #thiruvalluvar #tamil #tamilquotes #wisdom

reel.meaning: Hanuman replied: all of it was your power, Lord. None of the greatness is mine.
reel.caption:
Strength and devotion, the Hanuman way 🚩

📖 Tulsidas, Ramcharitmanas, Sundarkand 33 (Hanuman's words)

रोज़ एक वाणी के लिए Follow करें। 🙏
